overview_description.description:
Foreman is an open source lifecycle management tool for physical and virtual servers. It helps system administrators manage servers throughout their lifecycle, from provisioning and configuration to orchestration and monitoring. It provides interaction facilities, including a web frontend, CLI, and RESTful API.

System administrators can use Puppet or Chef and Foreman’s smart proxy architecture to automate repetitive tasks, deploy applications, and manage change, both on-premise with VMs and bare-metal or in the cloud. They can collect Puppet, Chef, and Salt reports and facts; and monitor host configuration, report status, distribution, and trends.

product.name: Foreman
product.description: An open source lifecycle management tool for physical and virtual servers, providing provisioning, configuration, and monitoring capabilities.

product.name: Foreman Installer
product.description: A Puppet-based installer that automates the installation and configuration of Foreman and its components using native OS packages.

product.name: Smart Proxy
product.description: A web-based component that manages remote services like DHCP, DNS, TFTP, Puppet, and others, enabling Foreman to orchestrate host provisioning and management.

product.name: Foreman API
product.description: A RESTful API providing programmatic access to Foreman’s features for automation and integration with other systems.

product.name: Foreman CLI (Hammer)
product.description: A command-line interface tool for managing Foreman resources and automating tasks via the Foreman API.
